intro.label: Traditional Sardinian cuisine
intro.title: A journey through the flavours of the island
intro.subtitle: Every dish tells the story and traditions of southern Sardinia. We use only fresh, local ingredients, selected from the finest producers of the Sulcis and Campidano regions.

menu.note: The menu changes according to the season.

colazione.label: Every morning
colazione.title: Traditional Sardinian breakfast included
colazione.paragrafo: The day begins with a rich and wholesome breakfast: pane carasau, fresh cheeses, artisan jams, traditional pastries, fruit juices and locally baked goods. An authentic way to start your discovery of Sardinia.
